user.title: Nivuus guest VPN
user.description: Connect to the Nivuus system agent, which runs the guest network's VPN. The upload form is then under this integration's Configure button.

data_description.host: The agent listens on this machine only: keep 127.0.0.1.

error.cannot_connect: The agent cannot be reached at this address.
error.timeout: The agent did not answer in time.

init.title: Guest VPN profile
init.description: Upload the profile from your VPN provider. It replaces the current one; the username and password are sent to the agent and not kept by Home Assistant.

data_description.ovpn_file: The .ovpn file your provider gives for the chosen server.
data_description.ca_file: Only for providers that ship the CA as a separate .crt or .pem file.
data_description.username: The username of your VPN account, not of Home Assistant.
data_description.password: The password of your VPN account.

error.cannot_connect: The agent cannot be reached. Check the integration's address.
error.invalid_auth: The agent refused the stored token. Remove and add the integration again with the current token.
error.timeout: The agent did not answer in time. The import may still be running: check the guest VPN state.
error.activation_failed: The profile was saved, but the tunnel did not come up: {reason}
error.not_utf8: This file is not UTF-8 text.
error.upload_missing: This upload is no longer available. Choose the file again.
